notes.title: Development Update 05/30/2025
notes.content:
Hey, storm chasers! Here's an update on the latest development progress for the game.

[h1]Updated Radar System[/h1]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44990296/8f53fbd9bf9d58a9629809de1dd976704894f613.png[/img]
[i]Reflectivity Scan[/i]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44990296/cb099bf7aaa46d0cac879fd430b56effec38571f.png[/img]
[i]Velocity Scan[/i]

The radar and map system has been overhauled with new hover popups for warnings, a spotter network showing other players as green blips, and visibility for your placed probes and storm reports. Lightning bolts tracked by radar stations are now displayed, and there's an alert indicator in the top right showing the count and highest severity of active warnings.

[h1]Minimap[/h1]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44990296/7a877ba4489128698c70616fbc126f1eb80c7954.png[/img]
[i]Trees not visible in screenshot for development purposes[/i]

Added a minimap to the bottom left of the HUD for navigation and awareness.

[h2]Short Range & Damaged Radar Stations[/h2]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44990296/b4c013040d5aae7ad3a8ec493bbff21c2f5c4fb6.png[/img]
[i]Yellow/orange blips show short range stations, red blips show destroyed stations[/i]

Short-range radar stations (yellow/orange blips) have been added, similar to those found at airports and schools. Radar stations can now be destroyed and will show their last scan with a red blip indicator.

[h2]Radar Station 3D Models[/h2]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44990296/4bb5badc90eb26d10d28a4b33eeba618aed45a18.png[/img]
[i]Radar station models[/i]

Added 3D models for radar stations.

This is a smaller development update as I've been busy with final exams. At this point, the main tasks remaining before release are tweaking, bug fixes, and adding the rest of the vehicles and player outfits.

notes.title: Development Update 04/20/2025
notes.content:
Hey, storm chasers! Here's an update on the latest development progress for the game.

[h1]New Tornado Visuals[/h1]
[i]Completely reworked tornado shader for more realistic appearance[/i]

I've completely reworked the tornado shader. Previously, the tornado was rendered via effects being applied to a procedural cone geometry. Now, the tornado uses volumetric effects to create a more realistic appearance as well as fit in better with the volumetric clouds.

[previewyoutube=ud0ByDpwp70;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=DPE8TV_Byeg;full][/previewyoutube]

The new shader allows for much greater control over the tornado's appearance, enabling much larger tornados as well.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44990296/098cbf35dab027cdb5a1bd94458fa6537009aa29.png[/img]

[h1]Map for Early Access[/h1]
[i]Current map details and future expansion plans[/i]

While the map is still expanding and will continue to be improved, currently there are 3 populated areas/3 counties, with the rest being highway and rural roads. The map is 15 x 15 km or 265 km². While the amount of roads may appear small, the length of each road is quite long.

notes.title: Development Update 03/02/2025
notes.content:
Hey, storm chasers! I've been working hard towards the playtesting phase and am excited to share some of the progress made in the past few weeks.

[h2]Bloodhound Interceptor[/h2]

The new Bloodhound interceptor is now fully implemented, and ready to intercept! This vehicle will be a fun item in your storm chasing arsenal.
[i]Modeled by Thunder Morningstar[/i]

[h3]Bloodhound Deployment[/h3]
[previewyoutube=Lr55GBxSAIc;full][/previewyoutube]
Watch as the Bloodhound deploys its equipment in the field.

[i]Bloodhound in the Garage[/i]
[previewyoutube=6eO7NyU34Aw;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Interior of the Bloodhound[/i]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44990296/3f1a594cd932fbb7f261ea242816dc9eba53a7fc.png[/img]

[h2]Improved Tornado Visuals[/h2]

I've made some improvements to our larger tornado visuals. While this is still a work in progress, we wanted to share the current state of these enhancements.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44990296/3644892c004c9e865d29c7dada40d6969751ff8d.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44990296/f08a986fe2cdb37d2ea2f6bff006e61b47c7d819.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44990296/2d38c503322ddc0fafff1b9ab61a8e1687f8eae9.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44990296/0bd1c3288e437de78598063cb519d20ff1258bce.png[/img]

[h2]Multiplayer Progress[/h2]

I'm excited to announce that we've begun internal multiplayer testing! Our servers are up and running, and we are actively tracking issues on our bug board.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44990296/ba3c776ab09ad64aa0f42b901e88943d0997bc5f.png[/img]
A glimpse of our multiplayer menu interface.

[h2]Bug Fixes & Optimizations[/h2]

Numerous bugs have been squashed over the past few weeks - mainly regarding multiplayer, improving stability and performance across the board. My focus has been on creating a smooth experience for the upcoming playtesting phases.

[list]
[*]Fixed various vehicle physics issues
[*]Improved weather system stability
[*]Enhanced performance in areas with multiple tornados
[*]Resolved several UI and menu glitches
[*][i]Many more[/i]
[/list]

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

The next phase of playtesting is on the horizon! Here's what you can expect:

[list]
[*]The next phase of playtesting is expected to begin either at the end of this month or early next month.
[*]Pre-Alpha Supporters can expect an official announcement for the above.
[*]Our current focus is on completing the EA map.
[*]Playtesting times and release dates will depend on how long it takes to complete the map and fix any bugs or performance issues discovered during testing.
[/list]

We're excited to have you experience the game firsthand soon! Thank you for your continued support and patience.

notes.title: Development Update 08/27/2024
notes.content:
Hello storm chasers! I'm excited to share the latest updates on our upcoming game, Tornado Emergency. As the primary developer, I've been hard at work implementing new features and polishing existing ones. Let's dive into what's new!

[previewyoutube=T9mZdGRVc-c;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Tornado System Improvements[/h2]

We've made significant strides in enhancing the tornado experience:

[list]
[*] Updated tornado shaders for more realistic visuals
[*] Improved the dropping down animation for a more dramatic effect
[*] Implemented a system for tornadoes to throw vehicles and people
[*] Added power flashes with sparks for increased realism
[*] Introduced tree destruction for more environmental interaction  
[/list]

[previewyoutube=3RpM84hTueU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Power Outage Feature[/h3]

[h2]Vehicle and Gameplay Enhancements[/h2]

Our vehicle system has seen major upgrades:

[list]
[*] Implemented a functional steering wheel for immersive driving
[*] Added an in-vehicle laptop with radar display
[*] Introduced hazard lights and emergency lightbars
[*] Currently working on 7 new vehicles, including two interceptors (images coming soon!)
[/list]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images//44990296/44bf8f390603ca6d7e8fe4cc119ed6efb6d4b6a1.jpg[/img]
First Person POV

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images//44990296/caf4e7a324199d1cbccaaf3dc6d67c23213a236b.jpg[/img]
Third Person POV

[h2]Radar and Weather Systems[/h2]

The radar system has received a significant overhaul:

[list]
[*] Updated radar now displays velocity and reflectivity
[*] Implemented TVS (Tornado Vortex Signature) icons and warnings
[*] Integrated tornado sirens with the radar system
[*] Added hail to our weather system
[*] Improved our cloud system for more realistic storm formations
[/list]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images//44990296/cb9d833135238c4b06725d7401a32eb45f63a1dd.png[/img]
New Radar System

[h2]Map and Environment[/h2]

Progress on our environment continues:

[list]
[*] The EA (Early Access) map is now 25%-ish complete
[*] Implemented a power outage system for added realism
[*] Experimenting with AI traffic to populate our world
[/list]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images//44990296/3e192e9f0354c9f85f4205e2205118f991daf03d.png[/img]
EA Map Progress

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images//44990296/4505601d07de2dc1f8ef77c770afafa5892af3a2.png[/img]
AI Traffic Experimentation

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

While this update showcases only one new vehicle, rest assured that we're hard at work on several more. We'll be sharing images of the additional interceptor and six other vehicles as soon as they're ready.

I'm thrilled with the progress made so far, and I can't wait to share more with you all. Remember, this is primarily a solo project with some occasional help, so your patience and support mean the world to me.

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for your continued interest in Tornado Emergency!
